nodes.title: Strict polarized unitary modules
nodes.statement: For a quadratic extension L/K of p-adic fields with p odd, fix an embedding L into the completed maximal unramified extension breve L. A principal hermitian O_L-module of signature (r,s), r+s=n>0, is a strict formal O_K-module X of relative K-height 2n and dimension n, with O_L-action i and principal relative polarization λ satisfying λ i(a)=i(a-bar)^∨ λ and det(T−i(a)|Lie X)=(T−a)^r(T−a-bar)^s for every a∈O_L. Strictness refers to the O_K-action on the Lie algebra. The absolute p-height is 2n[K:Q_p]. The relative dual and polarization are those of strict modules, compared to absolute Cartier duality through the chosen inverse different; they are not silently the absolute dual.
hypotheses: p>2; L/K quadratic; r,s nonnegative; n=r+s>0.

All local moduli are evaluated on locally noetherian schemes over the completed maximal unramified coefficient ring on which the residue characteristic is locally nilpotent; reduction means the scheme cut out by the uniformizer, not the reduced scheme.
proofSteps: Specialize the strict-module and relative-duality supplier to L/K, keeping the structural O_K-action on Lie X.
Impose the two-embedding determinant equation and the relative adjoint equation; inherit base change and isomorphisms from the supplier.
Record the absolute-height conversion and its distinction from absolute dimension.
acceptance: An unramified quadratic extension with K ramified over Q_p still has relative height 2n.
The polarization adjoint is conjugation on O_L.

nodes.title: Mihatsch relative comparison
nodes.statement: Suppose L/K is unramified quadratic and Q_p⊂K0⊂K. On locally noetherian nilpotent bases, construct Mihatsch’s equivalence C from supersingular hermitian O_L–O_K0-modules with signature P(r,s) and its structural-action Eisenstein clause to supersingular strict O_K hermitian O_L-modules of signature (r,s). For K/K0 unramified, contract the embedding-graded display by a full Frobenius round trip. For K/K0 totally ramified, lift the pairing through the inverse-different trace, pass through the Lubin–Tate frame and rescale by the frame-change unit. Compose along the unramified/totally ramified factorization. C is compatible with Rosati adjoints and polarized quasi-isogenies. Write Ψ for the K₀-embeddings of the maximal subfield Lᵘ⊂L unramified over K₀, split into conjugate halves Ψ₀,Ψ₁ with distinguished ψ₀∈Ψ₀. Put P₀₁(a;T)=∏_{ψ∈Ψ₁}ψ(charpoly_{L/Lᵘ}(a;T)), P₁₀=P₀₁(T−a)/(T−a-bar), and P(r,s)=P₁₀^r P₀₁^s; the indicated quotient is polynomial. Require this characteristic polynomial on Lie and (i(a)−a)|Lie_{ψ₀}=0 for every a∈O_L. This last zero-endomorphism equation is part of the input. On the O_K₀ side the relative height and dimension are 2n[K:K₀] and n[K:K₀]; the strict O_K side has height 2n and dimension n.
proofSteps: Use the requested polarized relative display/window equivalence and normal decompositions.
In the totally ramified case keep the inverse-different generator and the unit correcting the change of frame.
Identify contracted Hodge crystals and homomorphism lifting across square-zero thickenings, then induct along the nilpotent nilradical of a noetherian base.
acceptance: The comparison applies when K/Q_p is ramified; this is distinct from the exotic comparison in U4.
On the relative side the height is 2n, not the absolute height.

nodes.statement: Fix a supersingular principally polarized strict hermitian O_L-module 𝕏 of signature (1,n−1). The exact polarization normalization selects this component; a moduli problem allowing arbitrary similitude factors is a different functor.

nodes.title: Unitary diagonal graph
nodes.statement: For n≥2 and the chosen recursive framings, let δ:N_{n−1}→N_n be U1/product-embedding and set Δ=(id,δ):N_{n−1}→N_{n−1}×N_n. It is a closed immersion, equivariant for the diagonal copy of U(V_{n−1}) through the fixed unit-vector inclusion V_{n−1}→V_n. Its image has relative dimension n−2 in an ambient product of relative dimension 2n−3. In the arithmetic dimension convention including the coefficient DVR, its dimension n−1 is half the ambient dimension 2n−2; this distinction is retained for consumers.
proofSteps: Take the graph of the closed product-embedding map.
Use the chosen unit-vector summand to verify diagonal equivariance of its two components.
Compute relative and absolute dimensions separately.
acceptance: For n=2 the graph has relative dimension zero in relative dimension one.
For n=3 absolute dimensions are 2 and 4, while relative dimensions are 1 and 3.

nodes.statement: Assume K/Q_p is unramified of degree f and L/K is ramified quadratic as in U3. Exact-polarization arrows and the supersingular subcategory are retained.

nodes.title: Exotic relative functor
nodes.statement: Choose μ in the coefficient Witt units satisfying F^f(μ)/μ=∏_{i=1}^{f−1}F^{f−1−i}(ε_i). Define rel by retaining (P_0,Q_0), contracting F_0 through the normalized banal Frobenius maps F′_1,…,F′_{f−1}, and multiplying the retained pairing by μ. This gives a functor rel:Exo_Φ,b(n−1,1)→Exo_b(n−1,1) over noetherian nilpotent bases, preserving polarized morphisms and rational homomorphisms.
proofSteps: Solve the Frobenius difference equation for a unit μ in the chosen unramified coefficient ring.
Compose the normalized maps around the embedding cycle to obtain the relative display.
Check its display relations and pairing identities, using μ to cancel the ε-product.
acceptance: For f=1 choose μ=1; contraction and pairing correction are identities.

nodes.title: Absolute principal CM source comparison

nodes.title: Krämer normal-crossing charts
nodes.statement: Over the natural ramified coefficient DVR with p odd, the principal Krämer local-model charts meeting the exceptional locus have equation y(Σ_{i=1}^n x_i²)=2u with x_k=1, for some k. At an intersection point the residue quadric Σx_i²=0 is smooth, so this is étale locally yz=u times n−2 smooth parameters. For n≥3 this is the chart in Krämer03 (4.11). For n=2 the same equations give y(1+x²)=2u; at either geometric root of 1+x² the derivative 2x is invertible, giving the same crossing chart. This rank-two extension asserts local normal crossings and does not assert the global irreducibility of the n≥3 quadric.

Eliminate the symmetric matrix A and γ using A+uI=λγᵗ and λ_k=1 to obtain yΣx_i²=2u.
At quadric points use its nonzero gradient for an étale coordinate z=Σx_i²/2; away the quadric or y=0 use the smooth equation.
For n=2 check the two geometric roots explicitly, without importing the n≥3 geometric irreducibility assertion.
acceptance: The n=2 crossing is étale locally yz=u over O_breveL.
The n=2 residue quadric consists of two geometric points, so it is not claimed irreducible.
The chart after u=t^e with e>1 need not be regular.

nodes.title: Split Lubin–Tate and Drinfeld data
nodes.statement: At a split v₀ choose the factor w at which A[w^∞] is one-dimensional with structural O_{F,w}-Lie action and A₀[w^∞] is étale of O_{F,w}-rank one. This is the matched-CM-type condition after transporting the global signature convention; the other factor is its polarized dual. Define T[ϖ^m]=Hom_{O_{F,w}}(A₀[w^m],A[w^m]) as a finite flat Hom group scheme. Its direct limit under the transition maps determined by ϖ is a one-dimensional strict formal O_{F,w}-module T of local height n; étale locally a trivialization of the rank-one CM Tate module identifies it with A[w^∞]. This direct limit of finite Hom schemes is not Hom of the two entire p-divisible groups. For m≥1 a full Drinfeld level is an O_{F,w}-linear map ϖ^{−m}Λ_w/Λ_w→T[ϖ^m] whose sum of section Cartier divisors equals the full ϖ^m-torsion divisor on T. At m=0 the level datum is unique. Fullness does not require distinct sections on the special fibre.

Construct the finite Hom twists and uniformizer-dependent direct system; descend the local identifications with A[w^∞] and its strict structural Lie action.
Apply the supplier full Drinfeld torsion-divisor construction to T.
Relate generic full level to the principal congruence subgroup of the lattice stabilizer.
acceptance: At m=0 there is one level datum over each base object.
At m>0 in characteristic zero the zero map fails the full Cartier-divisor equation.

nodes.title: Almost self-dual local equations
nodes.statement: Over a perfect residue field k of a point of T_p, the completed local ring of the almost self-dual model is either W(k)[[t₁,…,t_{N−1}]], or, for N≥2, W(k)[[x₁,…,x_N]]/(x₁x_N−p). Thus the model is quasi-projective, regular and strictly semistable of relative dimension N−1 over the unramified coefficient ring. The N=1 model has only the first type. The balloon/ground/link geometry and tangent exact sequences of Theorem 5.2.5(2)–(5) are separate continuation targets; the present target supplies only the ambient local equations.
proofSteps: Normalize the local polarization pairing to diag(p,1,…,1).
Describe simultaneous Hodge line/hyperplane lifts and their orthogonality relation by Grothendieck–Messing.
In the crossing chart eliminate the remaining variables to obtain x₁x_N=p; in the other admissible charts solve for one variable to obtain a smooth power-series ring.
Check the impossible fourth rank case and the N=1 boundary before concluding semistability.
acceptance: For N=2 the crossing ring is W(k)[[x₁,x₂]]/(x₁x₂−p).
The ambient local rings are reduced and regular although the special fibre can cross.
After a ramified coefficient extension p=t^e with e>1, this argument supplies flatness but not regularity.

nodes.title: Integral level and Hecke system
nodes.statement: For fixed allowable integral p-type, form the system over sufficiently small prime-to-p unitary and CM compact opens. The Hecke map indexed by g in U(V)(A_{F⁺,f}^p) and a in the CM torus transports η^p to η^p∘g and η₀ to η₀∘a, with the source/target compact opens satisfying the usual inclusion; correspondences are indexed by K^p\U(V)(A_{F⁺,f}^p)/K′^p. The permitted level-forgetful maps are finite étale and compose compatibly. For the LTXZZ almost self-dual case use V° for the tame system and transport it through j in the generic comparison. At p only the separately constructed split Drinfeld tower is included.

Transport the two level structures on the same polarized abelian pair and verify the common-scalar arrow equivalence.

The unitary finite adeles are those of F⁺, not of the CM field F.

nodes.title: Smooth integral geometry and tangent space
nodes.statement: The neat smooth unitary model is a smooth quasi-projective scheme over T_p of relative dimension N−1. At a geometric point its relative tangent space is Hom(ω_{A∨,τ∞},H₁^dR(A)_{τ∞}/ω_{A∨,τ∞}), with source rank 1 and target rank N−1. Its generic fibre is the canonical unitary Shimura variety times the CM factor. Projectivity from properness of the generic fibre requires the separate integral properness supplier; it does not follow just from smoothness and quasi-projectivity. Here H₁^dR is the dual of the imported H¹_dR. On complex points the negative period line is Hom_C(H₁^dR(A₀)_{τ∞},ω_{A∨,τ∞}); the condition on the zero subspace ω_{A₀∨,τ∞} cannot define that line.
proofSteps: Compute the polarized Hodge deformation using the rank-one distinguished quotient; the other factors are banal.
Use neat levels and the polarized moduli ampleness supplier for scheme representability and quasi-projectivity.
Identify the generic canonical model; invoke an integral valuative/boundary argument separately for the conditional projectivity clause.

restructure.proposal: Keep the general input with SchemeAndStackFoundations; extend its named stage or create “SchemeAndStackFoundations, Part II” for the precise additional contract. Represent polarized PEL framed p-divisible deformation functors with quasi-isogenies on the uniformizer-zero base by separated formal schemes locally formally of finite type (RZ96 Theorem 3.25); allow fixed-height components, closed Lie/kernel conditions, canonical Artin-level effectivity and formal Yoneda/completion comparisons. Supply generic formal local-model charts, blow-up and infinitesimal smoothness transfer; do not assume the whole RZ space quasi-compact or p-adic. Part II here owns only the stated unitary specialization; no existing upstream roadmap file is changed.

restructure.detail: Generic descent and stacks are existing SF.1 targets; this requests the formal discrete-action interface needed by Θ.
restructure.proposal: Keep the general input with SchemeAndStackFoundations; extend its named stage or create “SchemeAndStackFoundations, Part II” for the precise additional contract. Supply effective descent and formal arithmetic quotients by discrete quasi-isogeny groups under the RZ proper-discontinuity and sufficiently-small-level hypotheses, with stabilizers, fibrewise CM partition and changes of level retained. The quotient must represent the orbit/sheaf functor, not just its geometric point set. Part II here owns only the stated unitary specialization; no existing upstream roadmap file is changed.

restructure.detail: The existing M4 cm-moduli-scheme node assumes p unramified in the CM field and one neutral component; LL21 Notation 5.6, LL22 Notation 4.19 and RSZ21 §3.3 need a more precise extension.
restructure.proposal: Keep the general input with PELModuli; extend its named stage or create “PELModuli, Part II” for the precise additional contract. Extend the CM moduli construction to specified polarization ideal a prime to p and selected ξ-components, including primes ramified in the global CM field. Under the stated local CM/reflex and maximal p-level hypotheses prove finite étaleness over the actual coefficient ring; permit an empty component and state nonemptiness separately. Supply CM torus cosets and canonical principal local CM lifts, without asserting all-prime smoothness for an arbitrary CM moduli problem. Part II here owns only the stated unitary specialization; no existing upstream roadmap file is changed.

restructure.detail: GN.2 owns general Hermitian local/global arithmetic; the new IntegralLattices roadmap concerns symmetric quadratic lattices and does not replace these O_L-Hermitian contracts.
restructure.proposal: Keep the general input with GeometryOfNumbersAndQuadraticArithmetic; extend its named stage or create “GeometryOfNumbersAndQuadraticArithmetic, Part II” for the precise additional contract. Supply Hermitian local determinant/norm-class classification, rational isocrystal-Hermitian realizations and their lattice types; Landherr existence/uniqueness with exactly the distinguished real and finite local invariants switched, product formula and the relevant unitary Hasse principle. Include self-dual versus length-one dual-quotient lattices, the rank-one source norm and odd/even determinant scaling. Part II here owns only the stated unitary specialization; no existing upstream roadmap file is changed.

restructure.detail: RSZ21 §5.1 uses this general reductive integral-model input. The unitary torsor/Hodge diagram remains U7’s application.
restructure.proposal: Keep the general input with ReductiveGroupsPartII; extend its named stage or create “ReductiveGroupsPartII, Part II” for the precise additional contract. Extend lattice-chain stabilizer schemes to the full automorphism group of a polarized O_L-linear periodic multichain over the stated odd-residue-characteristic DVRs, including the Weil-restricted factors when the ground extension is ramified. Prove the smoothness needed for its trivialization torsor and distinguish that group from its connected parahoric. Reuse RG2.3/lattice-chain-stabilizer-schemes (currently GL/GSp) and hodge-type-fixer-immersion; neither exact statement supplies smoothness of this full unitary multichain automorphism group. Part II here owns only the stated unitary specialization; no existing upstream roadmap file is changed.

restructure.detail: The current LT.3 marked universal deformation has no full Drinfeld-level theorem. ET.6a consumes the same formal-module owners for its tower; requesting the integral extension here avoids constructing a second tower.
restructure.proposal: Keep the general input with LubinTateFormalModulesAndQuasiCanonicalLifts; extend its named stage or create “LubinTateFormalModulesAndQuasiCanonicalLifts, Part II” for the precise additional contract. Export full integral Drinfeld level on a strict one-dimensional formal O_K-module of height n as an equality of effective Cartier torsion divisors. Prove representability, finite flatness over level zero, regularity of its universal finite-level deformation rings and the generic principal-congruence identification. Keep unramified coefficient extensions explicit; import LT.3/universal-deformation for level zero. Part II here owns only the stated unitary specialization; no existing upstream roadmap file is changed.

restructure.detail: Only the generic-fibre interface is imported. The proper integral resolution of the lifting divisor is now known by LRZ26 Theorem 14.6.2; this interface neither asserts an integral equality nor needs that divisor theory.
restructure.proposal: Keep the general input with AdicSpacesPartII; extend its named stage or create “AdicSpacesPartII, Part II” for the precise additional contract. For the locally finite-type formal charts of U2, supply generic fibres, coefficient base change, finite étale comparisons and the functor-to-generic-space identification used to prove π₁ generic finite étale of degree q+1 and π₂ an isomorphism onto its image. Glue on admissible charts without claiming the full RZ space quasi-compact. Part II here owns only the stated unitary specialization; no existing upstream roadmap file is changed.

restructure.detail: C5 supplies good-prime integral PEL compactifications and explicitly excludes arbitrary bad-prime extensions. This is the exact extra export behind U7 and LTXZZ22 Theorem 4.2.3’s last assertion.
restructure.proposal: Keep the general input with ShimuraCompactifications; extend its named stage or create “ShimuraCompactifications, Part II” for the precise additional contract. Extend the polarized-moduli ampleness/quasi-projectivity and valuative or flat-boundary properness argument to the particular unitary CM-pair integral models at the Eisenstein, almost self-dual and exotic local types used here. Under a proper generic Shimura fibre prove the integral pair model proper, then projective by the Hodge ample bundle. Keep the actual coefficient and neat-level hypotheses; generic properness alone is insufficient. Part II here owns only the stated unitary specialization; no existing upstream roadmap file is changed.

restructure.detail: The nearby inner form and essential surjectivity of Θ use the basic comparison in RZ96 §§6.27–6.30, beyond the current number-field R28.4 contract.
restructure.proposal: Keep the general input with FaltingsFinitenessAndIsogenyTheorems; extend its named stage or create “FaltingsFinitenessAndIsogenyTheorems, Part II” for the precise additional contract. Extend the number-field isogeny-theorem exports with finite-field Tate’s theorem and the basic CM/PEL rational Tate–Dieudonné comparison over an algebraically closed residue field under the commutative-center/basic-isotypic hypotheses of RZ96 Corollary 6.29. Identify polarized quasi-isogenies and global rational Hom with the relevant Hermitian realization; do not infer the algebraically closed statement from a single finite-field Galois-equivariance condition. Part II here owns only the stated unitary specialization; no existing upstream roadmap file is changed.

restructure.detail: These are general abelian-scheme theorems from the Zhang route, not new PEL definitions. Newton identities plus trace nondegeneracy give F-valued coefficients; geometric connectedness of each invertible-ℓ open is not assumed. This owner export accounts for the two routed general theorems; no extra local-moduli target is invented merely to consume them.
restructure.proposal: Keep the general input with AbelianSchemesAndArithmeticModuli; extend its named stage or create “AbelianSchemesAndArithmeticModuli, Part II” for the precise additional contract. Export Zhang21 Lemma 7.10(b): for an O_F-linear rational endomorphism of an abelian variety, the characteristic polynomial on its F⊗Q_ℓ Tate module is in F[T] and independent of ℓ≠char(k), with each embedding component recovered by trace pairing. Export Lemma 7.11: both ordinary rational and F-linear polynomials are constant over a connected family, clearing denominators and descending coefficients across connected étale covers. Reuse A6/degree-of-an-endomorphism, charpoly-of-endomorphism and charpoly-on-Tate for Lemma 7.10(a). Part II here owns only the stated unitary specialization; no existing upstream roadmap file is changed.
